name: spaceship-x26
description: SpaceshipX26 — React + TypeScript frontend (client) and Express + TypeScript backend (server)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.dev: concurrently --names "server,client" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix server && npm run test --prefix client
